lines.l: I live with it, now I'm there, I'm alive, I can't just stumble in it
Wherever you go, whatever you do
You know these reckless thoughts of mine are following you
I'll fall in for you, whatever you do
Cause baby you've shown me so many things that I never knew
Whatever it takes, baby I'll do it for you
Foolish feeling in our hearts on the table
Now we're there, fire alive, we'll catch us
Oh, and I was so free
But baby, that's not what I wanted to be
Cause baby, you showed me so many things that I'd never see
Whatever you need, baby, you got it for me
Our love is alive, and so we begin
Foolishly laying our hearts on the table
Now I'm there for our lives
I'll see you in my heart, so the table, so my baby.
